question: Which of the following provinces had maximum representation in the constituent assembly of India as on 31st December, 1947?
solution:
The correct answer is__** the United Province**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The province with the** ****maximum representation** in the Constituent Assembly of India on that date was **United Provinces**
 
• 
 
**Uttar Pradesh, then known as the United Provinces,** was one of the most populous and politically active regions in India.

 
 
• Its** demographic weight t**ranslated into a substantial number of representatives.
 
• The United Provinces** had a rich history of political activism,** social reform movements, and intellectual discourse.
 
• Several influential leaders from Uttar Pradesh played **pivotal roles in shaping India’s destiny**.
 
• Notable figures like
 
 
• **Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru**, **Sardar Patel**, and **Dr. Rajendra Prasad** were actively involved in the Constituent Assembly proceedings.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Constituent Assembly of India**

 
 
• The Constituent Assembly was **specifically elected to draft the ****Indian Constitution.**
 
• It was formed after India gained** independence from British colonial rule in 1947.**
 
• The assembly consisted of **299 members**, representing various regions, communities, and ideologies.
